instructions_to_main_agent: Use lucide-react for all icons (Dashboard, Store, Users, Settings, Shield, Package, Blocks, Activity).
Ensure 'Outfit' font is imported via Google Fonts for headings, and 'Inter' for body.
Implement Shadcn/UI for foundational components (Button, Input, Table, Badge, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Sheet, Switch).
The layout must have a sticky top navbar containing the Tenant Switcher Dropdown (for multi-tenant context) and a user profile dropdown.
The Sidebar must contain navigation for: Overview, Outlets, Modules (POS, Billing, Inventory, etc.), Users & Roles (RBAC), Settings, Integrations, Audit Logs.
For the Tenant/Business Dashboard, use the 'Control Room' grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) with high-density data widgets (e.g., Active Outlets, MRR, Active Users, System Status).
Use the Sheet component (Slide-over drawer) for 'Add New User', 'Edit Role', or 'Configure Module' instead of navigating to separate pages. This preserves context.
The Settings Engine should be a complex page utilizing Tabs (General, Branding, Modules, Feature Flags) and Switch toggles for enabling/disabling features per tenant.
Tables must be dense (py-2 px-4) with an actions column (3 dots DropdownMenu) at the end of each row. Use badges for Status (Active/Inactive) and Roles.
Seed realistic demo data using the provided avatars and logos in the media array. Do not use placeholder images like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure the MVP focuses heavily on Tenant Management, RBAC, Module Registry, and the Settings Engine.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, dropdown triggers, toggles) for testing, using kebab-case role-based names.
